component.name: TuxStack
component.summary: Docker and Incus desktop management for Linux
Linux 上的 Docker 与 Incus 桌面管理工具

description.p: TuxStack is a native Linux desktop manager for Docker and, in future releases, Incus. It is designed for KDE Plasma and built with Rust, Qt Quick, Kirigami, and a typed local daemon protocol.

The unprivileged tuxstackd user service is the sole Docker Engine client. The GUI communicates over authenticated local Unix-socket IPC, while a persistent read-only FUSE namespace exposes containers, images, and volumes as ordinary directories under ~/TuxStack/docker.

Container lifecycle, Compose-label grouping, live stats and logs, interactive TTY terminals, image/network/volume operations, and unified read-only Files browsing are implemented. Incus support remains planned.
Docker Containers workflows, typed tuxstackd IPC, and unified read-only FUSE filesystem browsing.
Read-only image and volume filesystem browsing with a bundled static Rust helper.
Initial alpha release for Docker resource management.
